name: Recipe Trade Up
title: Trade Up Contract
description: In exchange for several items of identical quality, you will receive a single item of a quality one higher, from a collection of one of the items you provided.

name: Remove Keychain Tool
title: Charm Detachments
description: Select a weapon with an attached charm. Using a Charm Detachment will detach the charm and return it to your inventory.

name: Name Tag
title: Name Tag
description: This item will rename a weapon. A custom engraved nameplate will be applied to the weapon and viewable in game.

name: casket
title: Storage Unit
description: The Storage Unit allows you to store up to 1,000 of your surplus items which would otherwise exceed inventory limit. At any time you can move items from your inventory into the Storage Unit, retrieve items back into your inventory, or you can just use it to organize your collectibles.

name: sticker
title: Sticker
description: This sticker can be applied to any weapon you own and can be scraped to look more worn. You can scrape the same sticker multiple times, making it a bit more worn each time, until it is removed from the weapon.

name: patch
title: Patch
description: This patch can be applied to any agent you own. Once applied, it can be removed but not recovered.

name: Gift - 1 Player
title: Gift Package
description: When used, a random player in your match will get a random item as a gift from you.

name: Gift - 9 Players
title: Pallet of Presents
description: When used, up to 9 other players in your match will get a random item as a gift from you.

name: Gift - 25 Spectators
title: Audience Participation Parcel
description: When used, up to 25 viewers watching your match will get a random item as a gift from you.

name: stattrak_swap_tool
title: StatTrak™ Swap Tool
description: This item swaps StatTrak™ values between two of the same item type.

name: spray
title: Sealed Graffiti
description: This is a sealed container of a graffiti pattern. Once this graffiti pattern is unsealed, it will provide you with enough charges to apply the graffiti pattern 50 times to the in-game world.

name: spraypaint
title: Graffiti
description: This graffiti can be applied to the in-game world. You can apply it until you run out of charges.

name: keychain
title: Charm
description: This charm can be attached to any weapon you own. Each attached charm can be detached by using a Charm Detachment. Detached charms will be returned to your inventory.

name: Remove Keychain Tool Pack
title: Charm Detachment Pack
description: Charm Detachment Pack will give you 3 Charm Detachments. Each Charm Detachment allows you to detach one applied charm. The detached charm will appear in your inventory.

name: xpgrant
title: Bonus Rank
description: This item grants you a bonus Rank when used. It does not consume your weekly XP bonus boost and will not affect your weekly item drop eligibility.

name: subscription1
title: Counter-Strike Subscription Service
description: This item activates your monthly Counter-Strike Subscription Service. You can cancel your Counter-Strike Subscription Service at any time before the next billing cycle.

name: tournament_pass_katowice2019
title: Katowice 2019 Viewer Pass
description:
This is a sealed IEM 2019 Katowice CS:GO Major Championship viewer pass. Once this pass is unsealed, it will provide you with the Katowice 2019 Coin tracking your progress throughout the event, full access to the Katowice 2019 Pick'Em Challenge, exclusive access to Souvenir Packages, Steam.tv chat flair, and unlimited team graffiti for the duration of the event.

You can upgrade your Katowice 2019 Coin by completing challenges. You can redeem a Souvenir Package every time you upgrade your Coin.
